summary_rationale: Marine Electricals (India) Ltd. combines a defensible Indian Navy/Coast Guard electrical qualification moat with explosive secular order-book growth in hyperscale data center Power Train Units (₹3,514 Cr total backlog as of Sep 2026, 87.2% Industry/Data Centres; [ICRA]A- rating; 18.0% ROCE). However, it fails the capital-light compounder bar on cash conversion and capital discipline: 10-year cumulative CFO/PAT is 44.5% (₹93 Cr CFO vs ₹209 Cr PAT) with -₹48 Cr cumulative FCF, Debtor Days remain elevated at 178 days, 3-year average ROE is 12.1%, and growth has required repeated equity dilution (2018 IPO, 2024 preferential/warrants) alongside a 3.01% promoter stake sale in Sep 2026 (down to 65.19%).
